purpose: AT-17A demo/smoke Compose profile (docker-compose.demo.yml) — minimal deterministic DEM fixture so backend-public's DEM loader (backend/elevation_service.py) can load successfully and /api/stats returns 200 in the demo profile.
prohibited_scope: real disaster / evacuation decision — this fixture MUST NOT be used to inform real elevation lookups, hazard judgement, or evacuation routing. Values are not real elevation measurements.

file.format: GTiff (single-band float32 GeoTIFF, read via rasterio — same library/contract as backend/elevation_service.py and backend/requirements.txt rasterio==1.4.3)

crs_note: JGD2011 geographic 2D — same CRS as the production DEM. Values are synthetic, not real geodesy.
axis_convention: Standard north-up GeoTIFF (DEM-RUNTIME-REPAIR, 2026-10-12): column axis (x) = longitude, west to east; row axis (y) = latitude, north to south. The production DEM used to have a swapped latitude/longitude layout, which turned out to misplace 3rd-order mesh tiles; backend/elevation_service.py now refuses swapped DEMs (fail closed), so this fixture uses the standard layout.

fixture_bbox.note: demo OSM bbox fully covered with a 0.02 deg margin on every side, so interpolation always has valid neighbor cells and no corner of the demo OSM bbox sits on the fixture's edge.

elevation_formula: elevation(row, col) = 8.0 + 6.0*sin(col*0.35) + 4.0*cos(row*0.28) + 0.05*(row+col), where row indexes the latitude axis (north to south) and col indexes the longitude axis (west to east). Deterministic, no RNG, fixed coefficients embedded directly in generate_synthetic_dem.py.

nodata.location: rows 47-49, cols 51-53 (south-east corner of the fixture), 9 cells total — deliberately placed far from the demo OSM bbox interior so /api/stats and interpolation over the demo bbox are unaffected.
nodata.contract: backend/elevation_service.py::ElevationService._is_nodata() treats any value <= -9999.0 as NoData unconditionally, in addition to the GeoTIFF's own declared nodata tag (also set to -9999.0 here).

expected_statistics.note: min/max/mean computed over the 2691 valid (non-nodata) cells of the generated array; used by tests/fixtures/dem_demo validation tests and by the AT-17A focused Docker verification to confirm the loaded dataset matches this fixture exactly.

api_stats_expected_response.note: GET /api/stats returns elevation_service.dataset.bounds/.width/.height/.crs directly (backend/app_public.py get_statistics()). With the standard layout, bounds.left/right are the longitude range and bounds.bottom/top the latitude range.

license: N/A — fully synthetic, no third-party data. Not derived from any real elevation dataset. No attribution required.
reproducibility: Regenerate with: python3 tests/fixtures/dem_demo/generate_synthetic_dem.py --output tests/fixtures/dem_demo/elevation_demo.tif (deterministic: two runs on the same rasterio/GDAL version produce a byte-identical file, verified in tools/public_release/test_phase2d_dem_fixture_selfcheck.py).
